name: ProjectQ
description: ProjectQ is an open-source quantum computing framework developed at ETH Zurich. It features a modular compiler pipeline that can target classical simulators or real quantum hardware, and includes a high-performance C++ simulator capable of emulating up to about 30 qubits on a standard laptop.
